title: Bare Mines
description: Barebones, our favourite resource pack, now on 25w14craftmine!
body:
Bare bones is a simplistic texture pack that manages to revive the trailer look. Craftmine is a silly but fun april fools version that offers infinite posibilities.

But what if you could merge both? That's Bare Mines' premise.

By the way, shoutout to robotpants for making the original texture pack. Without him, I could have never done this.
How to apply:

- Download Bare Bones from Robotpants ([download here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones))
- Download Bare Mines
- On minecraft go to options and resource packs
- Put BareBones below Bare Craftmine
